local_expression: Shared chrome, post author and thread components. Canonical type sizes/leading are retained; scalable insets contain browser font ink. David’s Threads screenshot guides a single rounded reading-column outline, post dividers, inline author/timestamp and a viewport-anchored outlined Write control. His text specifies bottom left and the existing account-avatar position, with no sidebar. Header placement from daoUI’s earlier reading guidance is adapted for this use case. The post layout wraps for enlarged text; a separate lower action area prevents Write from covering the scroller. Reading width, preview-only fixture state and this composition remain local choices. Gold action colors retain David’s existing approved Jera mapping in the composer. Post options and heart/comment/repost/send anatomy follow David’s follow-up request. Only comment and the Copy text menu action are enabled. The finite authored sample set contains forty root posts and twenty replies; it establishes composition at length, not pagination or virtualization.
limits: No login, network requests, backend writes or live model replies
Post and per-thread drafts reset on reload
Web evidence does not establish native typing or sheet behavior
